rationale: The agent correctly verified the user using full name + zip and matched to a single profile, located the relevant order and item, checked product variants, and selected an in-stock alternative. However, before making the order-changing write, policy requires stating the exact change and obtaining explicit user confirmation. The agent proceeded to modify the order after saying "I will proceed" without first securing an explicit confirmation to proceed following the stated change and price. While the user's prior message indicated interest in the size 9 leather option, the policy calls for explicit consent prior to committing changes. The rest of the information (price difference refund to PayPal, updated item details) appears consistent with tool outputs, but the lack of explicit confirmation before the write fails the pass bar.
